# Quia

> > Quia is an educational platform for creating and sharing interactive games, quizzes, and activities for K-12 and college classrooms.

Quia Web provides teachers with tools to build engaging learning activities including battleship games, challenge boards, and interactive quizzes across subjects like math, language arts, social studies, and foreign languages. The platform integrates with Google Classroom and supports diverse educational content from civics to Latin grammar.

## Key Topics

- Educational games and quizzes
- Battleship game format
- Teacher-created activities
- Google Classroom integration
- Review and practice activities
- K-12 education
- Subject areas: Math, Civics, Latin, ESL
- Interactive learning tools
- Challenge boards
- Grammar practice
- Constitution and civics review
- Word study activities
- Account creation and login
- Java-based games

## Platform Overview

- [Quia - Quia Web](https://www.quia.com/): Homepage for Quia educational games, quizzes, and surveys platform

## Social Studies & Civics Activities

- [Quia - C- Constitution Test Review](https://www.quia.com/ba/694401.html): Constitution test review battleship game by Mr. Jones

## Language Arts & ESL Activities

- [Quia - Word Study: Verbs ending in -x, -s, -z, -sh, -ch](https://www.quia.com/jg/1133186list.html): ESL verb conjugation game by Diane Stonebrink, Estrella Mountain CC

## Foreign Language Activities

- [Quia - Stage XXI Grammar : Perfect Passive Participles](https://www.quia.com/ba/321060.html): Latin grammar battleship game for perfect passive participles practice

## Mathematics Activities

- [Quia - 7th Grade Math Knowledge](https://www.quia.com/cb/274767.html): 7th grade math challenge board covering decimals, fractions, rounding
